label: Synthetic sample identifier
allowed_values: unique string; synthetic IDs use SYN-T-###, SYN-V-###, SYN-E-###
description: Row identifier. Synthetic identifiers are not derived from and do not overlap with study identifiers.

label: PAS-positive macrophages
description: Prespecified three-level histopathological category for PAS-positive macrophages in the portal tract. The locked model's internal feature name is PAS_.Macrophages.

label: MUM1-positive cells per portal tract
allowed_values: positive finite number; study range approximately 1-700
description: Average number of MUM1-positive cells per portal tract, entered as a continuous variable.

label: Binary outcome
description: Outcome label. In the manuscript, Group = 1 is AIH (case) and Group = 0 is control. The synthetic fixture uses the same 0/1 coding.

label: Data split
description: Fixed split label. train is used for model development; internal_test and external_test are held out. Splits are disjoint by sample_id.
